description: A free invoice generator that makes a real PDF — no watermark, no sign-up. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'DKK'. It decides the symbol and decimals shown; an unknown code is refused with an error rather than guessed.

from.description: The sender's name and address as free text; line breaks are kept.

issueDate.description: The date the invoice is issued, as YYYY-MM-DD. The due date is counted from it, and its year goes into the generated invoice number.

items.description: The lines to bill, in the order they should appear.
One line on the invoice; its amount is quantity times unitPriceCents.

description.description: What the line is for, as printed on the invoice: 'Consulting, March', 'Logo design'.

quantity.description: How many units of the line. Fractions are allowed: 1.5 hours, 0.25 days.

unitPriceCents.description: The price per unit in the currency's minor unit, so 1999 means 19.99. Integers only. A negative value makes a discount line.

locale.description: The BCP 47 locale the amounts are formatted in, e.g. 'en-US' writes 1,234.56 and 'da-DK' writes 1.234,56. It does not translate the labels.

notes.description: Free text printed under the totals: payment details, bank account, terms, a thank-you. Empty prints nothing.

number.description: Your own invoice number, printed as given. Overrides the one built from sequence.

paymentTermsDays.description: How many days after issueDate payment is due. 0 means due on the issue date.

pdf.description: Include the rendered PDF as base64 in pdfBase64. Set false to get only the number, due date and totals, which is faster and much smaller.

sequence.description: The position in your invoice series, used to build the number as INV-<year>-<sequence padded to 4 digits>, e.g. 7 in 2026 gives INV-2026-0007. Ignored when number is given.

taxLabel.description: What the tax line is called on the invoice: 'VAT', 'MwSt', 'Moms', 'GST'.

taxPercent.description: Tax added on top of the subtotal, as a percentage: 25 adds a quarter. 0 leaves the total equal to the subtotal.

to.description: The customer's name and address as free text; line breaks are kept.

name: invoice_generator
title: Invoice Generator
